user.title: Set up HeatShift
user.description:
HeatShift moves your heat pump to the cheapest hours of your dynamic energy contract.

Use is voluntary and at your own risk. HeatShift is provided as is, without any warranty. The makers and the installer are not liable for damage, higher energy costs or loss of comfort. Steering stays off until you turn on the HeatShift switch.

data.accept_disclaimer: I have read this and accept it

data_description.price_sensor: Sensor with today's prices per quarter or hour, for example Frank Energie Prices today.
data_description.offset_entity: Offset: for example Altherma Leaving Water Offset. Room thermostat: the thermostat that controls the heat pump.
data_description.water_heater: Optional. Needed for hot water planning.
data_description.tank_sensor: Optional. If empty, the temperature of the water heater is used.
data_description.control_mode: Offset: shifts the leaving water temperature of the heat pump. Room thermostat: shifts the room setpoint by half degrees.

error.no_prices: This sensor has no price list HeatShift can read.
error.must_accept: You need to accept the terms to continue.
error.not_offset_entity: This entity does not look like an offset (range around 0). Pick the offset entity or choose Room thermostat.
error.not_thermostat_entity: This entity does not look like a room thermostat. Pick the thermostat or choose Offset.
error.base_outside_limits: The base temperature must lie between the lower and upper limit.

abort.already_configured: HeatShift is already set up for this heat pump.

data.cheap_threshold: Cheap up to (position in day range)
data.dhw_enabled: Plan hot water in the cheapest block

data_description.expensive_threshold: 0% is the cheapest price of the day, 100% the most expensive. Above this value the expensive offset is used.
data_description.cheap_threshold: Below this value the cheap offset is used. 0 turns it off.
data_description.tank_minimum: Below this temperature HeatShift always heats the tank, whatever the price.
data_description.base_temperature: The setpoint without price steering. HeatShift returns to this when it is switched off.

cop.title: Weather and COP
cop.description: HeatShift plans on heat cost: price divided by the COP. The COP depends on the outdoor temperature, so a warmer moment can be cheaper than a lower price.

data_description.weather_entity: Hourly forecast for the outdoor temperature per quarter. Without it HeatShift plans on price only.
data_description.outdoor_sensor: Optional. Used for the current moment and for measuring.
data_description.heating_lwt: Typical leaving water temperature for heating on a cold day.
data_description.cop_a7w35: From the datasheet of the heat pump. Leave both at 0 to use a physics estimate.
data_description.cop_a2w35: Includes defrost losses. Fill in both or neither.
data_description.cop_source: Measured: flow, supply and return temperature and power, for example from ESPAltherma. HeatShift learns a correction per degree outdoor temperature.

error.base_outside_limits: The base temperature must lie between the lower and upper limit.
error.datasheet_both: Fill in both datasheet values, or leave both at 0.
error.measured_sensors_missing: Measuring needs flow, supply, return and power sensors.
error.outdoor_missing: Measuring needs an outdoor temperature sensor or a weather forecast.
